exposure: Maternal pre-gravid and/or first trimester BMI
Women who delivered viable twins after 23 weeks of gestation
finding: In twin pregnancies, maternal pre-pregnancy overweight and obesity are associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, very preterm delivery, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found an increased rate of cesarean section in the obese group compared to the normal weight group (OR, 2; 95% CI, 1.2-3.4; P=0.006).
